text_simplified: Tarbiyah (upbringing) of children is a tremendous responsibility, and the Prophetic examples affirm the importance of discipline and care. Whoever raises three daughters, disciplines them well and teaches them good manners, provides for them, and shows them mercy, Paradise becomes obligatory for him. Good tarbiyah begins with the parents and encompasses care and guidance.

review_defects.why: The English adds 'and teaches them good manners' as a separate action not explicitly in the Arabic, though it is implied by good discipline.
«and teaches them good manners» is added as a separate clause; the Arabic «أحسن تأديبهن» means 'disciplined them well' without a distinct mention of teaching manners.
A well-known hadith is quoted without any source attribution.
